title: MARCA LUNA
description: An editorial photography portfolio with cinematic interactions and a content-managed gallery.
fullDescription: A personal portfolio concept for a photographer, exploring how interaction, pacing, and image-led layouts can give creative work more atmosphere.
challenge: Many creative portfolios are flat and dated, so the work loses atmosphere and clients move on.
approach: Turning a photography portfolio into a cinematic digital gallery rather than a simple image grid.

title: Solura
description: A Framer website exploring a clearer, more human way to communicate clean-energy services.
fullDescription: A personal clean-energy website project, combining service information, case studies, and a consultation journey in a responsive Framer build.
challenge: The site needed to explain solar products, build confidence in an emerging service, and guide visitors toward consultation.
approach: Making clean-energy technology feel human, understandable, and ready for action.

title: EarthHarvest Alliance
description: A nonprofit website concept built around impact stories, community, and a clearer donor journey.
fullDescription: A concept and high-fidelity prototype for a climate and agriculture nonprofit. This is a design exploration, not a launched website.
challenge: A climate and agriculture nonprofit needed a clearer, more compelling way to communicate impact and motivate donors and partners.
approach: Moving impact stories from dense text into a donor- and community-centred digital experience.

title: Momentum Coach
description: A focused landing-page concept that connects visitor questions with a clear consultation journey.
fullDescription: A personal coaching website project exploring offer positioning, content hierarchy, wireframes, and a logical booking flow.
challenge: Help busy professionals quickly understand the offer, trust the coach, and book a consultation.
approach: Designing a conversion page around real visitor questions, not just a polished layout.

title: Interior Designers
description: A reusable portfolio template for interior designers, with flexible layouts and CMS collections.
fullDescription: A personal Framer template designed to help interior designers present their projects, services, and writing without starting from zero.
challenge: Give interior designers an easy, customisable way to showcase work, services, and writing without starting from zero.
approach: Creating a reusable portfolio system with two CMS collections and flexible visual styling.
